evals.name: strings-intake-tiers-ranges
evals.prompt: i need search strings for my SLR on telemedicine adoption among older adults in rural areas. can you make them for scopus and wos?
evals.assumed_answers: field Public Health; population adults aged 60+; niche Malaysia; year ranges 2016-2020 and 2021-2026; systematic review; university has Scopus and Web of Science; wants the strings only; save in outputs.
assertions: Asked for the field and the year range(s) before writing strings
Web of Science strings for both ranges
More than one tier (broad / balanced / narrow) offered
Does not claim hit counts it never read

evals.name: prisma-record-reviewer-screening
evals.prompt: I've screened my records by title and abstract. My decisions: include R001 and R002, exclude R003 (wrong population: employees not students), maybe R004, exclude R005 (opinion piece, not empirical). Please record these and tell me my PRISMA numbers so far. records.json and search_log.json are in my project folder.
evals.assumed_answers: field Education; topic gamification and student motivation in Malaysian higher education; years 2021-2026; systematic review; project folder is the outputs folder.
assertions: All five decisions recorded in the project files exactly as the reviewer gave them
Exclusion reasons recorded for R003 and R005
R004 left as 'maybe' (not decided by Claude)
Reports screened 5, excluded 2, going to full text 3
Does not invent later PRISMA numbers (full text, included)
Makes clear the decisions were the reviewer's

evals.name: lrm-from-four-papers
evals.prompt: I have 4 papers already (text copies in the papers folder). Please make me a literature review matrix PDF with intro, methodology, results, discussion and theoretical framework columns, plus the journal quartile, method and whether it's free or paid.
evals.assumed_answers: field Education; topic gamification and student motivation; years 2021-2026; just the LRM; save in outputs. The quartile lookup may use web search if you have it.
assertions: All four papers in the matrix
No quartile invented for journals that cannot be looked up
Missing results shown as not retrieved, not invented
Missing framework shown as not stated
Access marked Unclear (no evidence of free or paid)
